name: 358-toddle
notes: User 2026-11-06 'Toddling is fine' (B2.d in the normal game, #192's babies): a walking-age baby (1 to 4) on its own feet after its real carer, as PeopleView draws it when the planner says carryOnFoot (LifePlanner.Toddle.cs: the carer's own carry, hands free, a walk of 1.2 u or less, at most 3 toddlers a day). The carer's day: stands, walks 0.9 u across the camp, stands, walks back. The toddler (a kid doll x 0.8) pottering on a short arc in front of the standing carer, wobbling 0.15 u behind the walking one (a little to the side), arms out, rolling; every 6-10 s it plops onto its bottom, sits a beat and gets up (the end beat); a carer standing near turns and bends to it. View/Beats/ToddleFollow.cs. AnimLab: cheat 'Toddlers walk: all' (adds a two-year-old if the box has none), then the hours 8:00-17:30.
